cases.selectionRationale: Closest saved holy-water cases cure a chaotic lycanthropic hero, including non-undead dwarf form. C v52 is a neutral vampire with no lycanthropy: mon_hates_blessings selects the holy-water damage arm89, without the affinity/cure continuation. The undead predicate and absent lycanthropy differ from the chaotic lycanthropic state.

closestSavedCoverage.sourceTrace: C potion.c758-760 calls you_unwere(TRUE) after blessed water cures illness and exercises stats. were.c215-226 prints purified and sets ulycn NON_PM. Step73 C You feel full of awe. You feel purified; JS peffect_water1167 records note_unported and skips cure/message. Later hunger RNG divergence follows changed input waits/state and is not the first cause.
closestSavedCoverage.recipeComment: Independent C-first B159 supplemental behavior: potion.c:peffect_water717-767 -> were.c:you_unwere; Acquire lycanthropy via tin, drink blessed water, inspect attributes. C observation target: Affinity to werewolves disappears and attributes exclude lycanthropy. Planned before comparison; no recipe altered in response to JS. C-only inventory/More/page/confirmation correction from recorded C before any supplemental JS comparison.

closestSavedCoverage.comment: Corrected C-first B82 dwarf-form cure recipe. The prior run reached dwarf form and set lycanthropy from the wererat tin, but C start_tin printed a second --More-- after the cooked tin's slippery-fingers effect; this input supplies the second dismissal before the potion wishes. The orc Wizard remains a chaotic CANNIBAL_ALLOWED role/race, and Upolyd skips allmain.c:328 while dwarf form avoids you_unwere's same-were-species condition. Keep the resulting session only if the C water cure executes and strict JS parity is complete.

cases.selectionRationale: Saved hostile disenchanter starts with Wizard cloak armor; regression glove drain is a hero melee passive_object path. C v52 removes all armor and wears +3 protection ring; no-armor fallback selects the ring and drains it160/196/208, changing protection. This checks the ring fallback instead of armor or weapon drain.

closestSavedCoverage.sourceTrace: A hostile disenchanter claw enters the monster-to-hero AD_ENCH path; C reaches the magic-negation gate and the JS side lacks this monster attack continuation.
closestSavedCoverage.recipeComment: C-first distinct attack-arm candidate for C59: hostile monster turn enters mhitu.c:hitmu -> uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping(AD_ENCH) -> mhitm_ad_ench. A Wizard-mode source-created disenchanter uses its claw, not a wished/eaten disenchanter corpse; two waits allow its C-observed adjacent hostile turn. The v17 drain-life-spell cases reach read.c:seffect_drain_life -> drain_item and change a wielded dagger; they do not reach this monster-to-hero AD_ENCH arm. No JS comparison has informed these inputs. This C-first correction preserves the seed, role, options, and move sequence, but uses 23:00 instead of invalid hour 29 because diff-fresh rejects the original YYYYMMDDHHMMSS value before comparison.

closestSavedCoverage.comment: Independent source-reaching witness for the hero melee -> passive AD_ENCH route. C-first setup wears a life-saving amulet, +9 dexterity gauntlets, and two +9 accuracy rings; it leaves the hero unarmed and spawns an adjacent sleeping disenchanter. After one resisted passive drain at step 222, step 223 has obj_resists rn2(100)=79; C then prints the glove less-effective message at step 224, with passive()'s trailing rn2(3) and the following mhitm_mgc_atk_negated monster-response gate in that boundary. The frozen recording ends at that complete visible drain result before later combat or death.
